brief:
A father in Gaza escorts his young daughter to school by bicycle amid the devastation surrounding them, according to Eye on Palestine. The pair navigate streets lined with ruins as the parent pedals the simple bike, creating moments of routine amid widespread destruction in the territory.

The scene captures daily life for residents attempting to maintain normalcy despite ongoing hardship. Families continue school runs and other ordinary activities even as buildings remain damaged and conditions remain difficult across Gaza. The father's decision to accompany his child to classes by bicycle reflects efforts by Palestinians to preserve childhood experiences and family routines in the face of widespread upheaval.
